newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: SM Prime to build new mall in Manila.
newsitem.headline: SM Prime to build new mall in Manila.

text.p: SM Prime Holdings Inc said on Tuesday it will start building the SM City-Manila mall in the second half of this year.
The planned construction of the new mall came after it announced last month it acquired the right to develop a 2.5-hectare property on Arroceros street in downtown Manila.
SM Prime said it planned to construct 160,000 square metres of gross floor area to accommodate 17 cinemas, a bowling center and a big entertainment area.
This will be the ninth of its chain of stores, it said, adding that it planned to accelerate its expansion to four mall constructions a year.
SM Prime is the biggest shopping mall operator in the Philippines.
